title: New RLNF System Trains AI to Decode Human Preferences From Brain Signals
summary:
Rahul Chhabra developed a reinforcement learning technique called RL with Neural Feedback, or RLNF, that allows AI models to optimize their outputs based on neural activity. Chhabra demonstrated the system by showing a picture of a face that morphed into a version the viewer found more attractive in real time as the AI decoded their brain signals.

The method bypasses standard feedback mechanisms such as clicks, ratings, or surveys to gather preference data directly from the human brain. This shift from using aggregated user behavior to individual neural feedback could enable the creation of hyper-personalized digital feeds and AI agents that adapt to specific tastes without requiring explicit user interaction.
